outcome: prevalence of disrespect and abuse (DAA) during childbirth
cohort: The study included 261 consenting postnatal women who had just given birth and were still in four public healthcare facilities in Lagos, Nigeria.
finding: The prevalence of disrespect and abuse (DAA) during childbirth was 82%, with non-consented care and abandonment/neglect being the most reported forms.
mod_finding: The odds for DAA were doubled in women who had vaginal delivery compared to Caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Immediately postpartum, while mothers were still in the hospital after birth.
